thread:
suresh: Heads up — seeing uptick in GPU errors across prod-us-east1 batch cluster. Xid 31 and Xid 13 bursts, but pattern is noisy/short-lived. Alert fired ~120 events in 10m. Anyone who owns the driver rollouts?

olivia: I saw that too. Looks tied to the 545.23 driver we pushed to canary last night. Logs show repeated 'NVRM: Xid' lines. Opening an incident.

jamie: tagging @oncall-sre. can you surface which instance types and kernel combos are most affected?

oncall-sre: I'm on it. preliminary nodemap: mostly A100p-40 + some A10g. Not all nodes with 545.23 have errors — seems correlated with long-running inference requests (larger seq lengths). Could be PCIe/link flakiness or a new nv_peer_mem interaction.

ana: sorry quick correction: this is ana not anaana :)

ana: (ignore)

ana: I've put together a quick idea: create an 'xid_entropy' detection metric = count_per_node / stddev_across_shard. If that rises above 3 we mark the host as "noisy". Then only page after noise persists 15m, otherwise send a non-urgent alert. That should cut the noise.

ana: Proposed alert rule:
```
- alert: XIDNoisyHost
  expr: (increase(nvidia_gpu_xid_total[5m]) / stddev_over_time(increase(nvidia_gpu_xid_total[5m])[1h])) > 3
  for: 15m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Host {{ $labels.node }} exhibiting high XID entropy"
```

suresh: Love it. Paste the PR when ready so we can avoid noisy pages during this investigation.

deploy-bot: canary rollback triggered by suresh — rolling driver 545.23 -> 543.12 on 8 nodes in prod-us-east1-c. status: 4/8 completed.

jamie: While rollback runs, please run these quick checks on any noisy nodes:
`kubectl -n infra exec $POD -- nvidia-smi -q | grep -i 'Xid' -A3`
`dmesg | grep -i nv.*xid`
`ethtool -S eth0 | egrep 'rx_|tx_'`
Check PCIe errors and link state.

olivia: Collected logs to s3://redwood-ops/xid-noise/1912345678/ — full dmesg, nvidia-smi dumps, and core dumps. Incident ticket linked.

oncall-sre: Noted. If rollback doesn't reduce noise in 20m we escalate to infra-eng for deeper driver/kernel bisect. Also applying temporary routing to divert batch to us-west for non-latency-sensitive jobs.

suresh: Assigning follow-ups: @ana implement alert tweak, @jamie verify kernel & PCIe configs on A100p nodes, @olivia collect crashdumps and attach. I'll draft a short runbook update and push to the runbooks repo.

jamie: :thumbsup: I'll also run quick MTU and netdev counters check — prior NCCL watchdog issues once were due to MTU mismatch on 10g links.

ana: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra-alerts/pull/876 — adds xid_entropy rule + 15m sustained suppression. cc @oncall-sre

olivia: Rollback finished 8/8. Initial error rate down ~85% over first 12m. Monitoring for 60m then will close incident if stable.

alertbot: INC-2026 created: xid-noise-us-east1. Severity: P2. Linked to thread 1912345678.
